latestAttribution.cause: The alchemist lineup repeated the confluence in 13.84 seconds with all four allies alive; the alchemist cast four skills, confirming the activity test, but contributed only 15.58% damage and no healing or shielding.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Restore the proven priest for the boss's flag-retaliation rule, because the priest showed substantial healing and shielding in the long flag trial while the alchemist did not.

latestAttribution.cause: Equipping the epic fire-mark charm on the mage raised displayed equipped power from 1099 to 1250, a gain of 151.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Before committing to the boss, briefly try the newly unlocked alchemist in the priest's support slot on the known confluence and observe whether it uses several support skills without destabilizing the clear.

latestAttribution.cause: Returning the priest to slot 2 restored the proven healing lineup while preserving the mage charm and 1250 displayed equipped power.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Challenge the chapter-2 boss with the upgraded damage core and the priest's proven healing and shielding under the flag rule.

hypotheses.problem: I do not yet know whether the newly visible drummer helps progression more than the incomplete spear militia.

hypotheses.problem: The team depends heavily on the warrior for damage and the barricade militia has contributed very little damage.
hypotheses.cause: The newly rescued complete mage may add more reliable damage than the incomplete barricade militia.

hypotheses.problem: The drummer's direct combat contribution fell to the lowest rank in the last fight.
hypotheses.cause: The newly rescued berserker may add stronger damage than the drummer while the healer offsets some of its visible low-health risk.

hypotheses.problem: The herb militia contributed little damage and died in the prison, while the newly unlocked ranger is untested.
hypotheses.cause: The ranger's sustained ranged attacks may add more reliable combat contribution than the herb militia provided.

hypotheses.problem: The berserker's recent damage rank has varied, while the newly unlocked full bard has no evidence.
hypotheses.cause: The bard may contribute through repeated team-support skills even without high personal damage.

hypotheses.problem: The berserker made no contribution in the latest fight, and the newly unlocked assassin is untested.
hypotheses.cause: The assassin's backline access and finishing behavior may produce stronger immediate damage against a full enemy team.

hypotheses.problem: The equipped berserker contributed little in the entry fight, and the newly unlocked warlock is untested.
hypotheses.cause: The warlock's damage-over-time and curse pattern may add meaningful damage against tougher rescue enemies.

hypotheses.problem: The warlock test was refuted, while the new knight's defensive value is unknown.
hypotheses.cause: The knight may stabilize the team by repeatedly generating shields and absorbing pressure.

hypotheses.problem: The knight's shield defense is known, but the newly unlocked priest's healing alternative is untested.
hypotheses.cause: The priest may stabilize the team through sustained healing when the flag trial opens a retaliation window.

hypotheses.problem: The priest is proven, while the newly unlocked alchemist's support activity is unknown.
hypotheses.cause: The alchemist may contribute through repeated potion and status-effect skills without needing top damage.
